# Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}}

Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}} is an offline-first study workspace. Your work is saved on your device; signing in to a DeepTutor server is optional.

## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Deep-Tutor-Pro-{{VERSION}}-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` | Windows 10/11 (64-bit) installer |
| `Deep-Tutor-Pro-{{VERSION}}-Android.apk` | Android 7.0 or later (install from file) |
| `deep-tutor-pro-web-{{VERSION}}.zip` | Web build: unzip and serve the folder from any static web server |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for the files above |

## Notes

- The desktop app now serves its pages from its own `app://tutor-pro` address instead of local files. Work saved by a 1.x desktop install is not carried over automatically.
- Voice notes ask for microphone access the first time you record; no other device permissions are requested.
- To use a DeepTutor server, sign in under **Settings -> Account & server**. Backups can be exported and imported under **Settings -> Sync, backup & data**.
